source: FDA Approved Prescribing Information & KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease

thresholds.reason: Contraindicated in severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m²) due to excessive drug accumulation and high mortality risk from metformin-associated lactic acidosis (MALA).
thresholds.evidence_source: FDA Drug Safety Communication (2016-04-08): Revised Warnings regarding use of diabetes medicine metformin in patients with reduced kidney function.

thresholds.reason: In moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30–44 mL/min/1.73m²), maximum recommended maintenance dose is 1000 mg/day with kidney function monitored every 3 to 6 months.
thresholds.evidence_source: ADA/KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Diabetes Management in Chronic Kidney Disease.

thresholds.dosage_interval_note: 150 mg daily as single dose or 300 mg every other day (QOD)
thresholds.reason: Severe renal impairment (CrCl < 15 mL/min): Gabapentin is eliminated almost exclusively by renal clearance. FDA Neurontin labeling restricts maintenance dosage to a maximum equivalent rate of 150 mg daily (or 300 mg every other day). Doses exceeding 150 mg/day carry severe risks of central nervous system toxicity, profound somnolence, myoclonus, and coma.
thresholds.evidence_source: FDA Neurontin (gabapentin) Prescribing Information, Section 2.3, Table 2: Neurontin Dosage Based on Renal Function.

thresholds.dosage_interval_note: 200 to 700 mg daily or 300 mg QOD to 350 mg BID
thresholds.reason: Renal impairment (CrCl 15–29 mL/min): FDA Neurontin labeling restricts total daily dosage to 200–700 mg/day. Exceeding 700 mg/day increases risk of toxic systemic accumulation.
thresholds.evidence_source: FDA Neurontin (gabapentin) Prescribing Information, Section 2.3, Table 2.

thresholds.dosage_interval_note: 100 mg daily or 100 mg every other day
thresholds.reason: Severe renal impairment (CrCl < 10 mL/min): Retention of active metabolite oxypurinol substantially increases hazard of fatal Allopurinol Hypersensitivity Syndrome (AHS). Maintenance dose must not exceed 100 mg daily or 100 mg at extended intervals.
thresholds.evidence_source: FDA Zyloprim Prescribing Information, Section 2: Dosage and Administration in Renal Impairment.

thresholds.reason: Moderate renal impairment (CrCl 10–20 mL/min): Maximum daily dose is 200 mg/day.
